text.title: Map I: The Border Fords & Weeping Ossuary
text.body: From the fortified timber palisades of Thornwick Market, march across six interconnected frontier regions to break High Quartermaster Morvessa's Salt-Tithe cordon, purge the Weeping Ossuary beneath Ravenwatch Keep, and open the southern road to Redmarsh.
text.obj.0: Main: Clear Sunken Ford and execute Chieftain Grok'tar
text.obj.1: Main: Relight Lantern Passage and slay Malgath, Chanter of the Pyre
text.obj.2: Main: Break the siege of Ravenwatch Keep's outer bailey
text.obj.3: Main: Descend into the Weeping Ossuary and slay Morvessa, the Silk Widow
text.obj.4: Main: Hold Alder Bridge cutwater against the eastern host
text.obj.5: Main: Breach Ashbrook Southern Gatehouse and defeat Commander Velen
text.obj.6: Side: Audit the Burned Border Mint ruins for Assayer Pell's scales
text.obj.7: Side: Harvest Vitrified Slag shards from the Old Kilns and slay Krazak
text.obj.8: Side: Liberate Greywood Sawmill and slay Skara, Matron of Frostquills
text.obj.9: Side: Hunt Thornmaw the Ironroot in the Craghorn Granite Quarry
text.obj.10: Side: Burn the Lower-Parish Probate Lien-Roll in the Sunken Scriptorium
text.obj.11: Side: Relieve water pressure behind Gallery Four in the Undervault Links
text.msg.1: [WAR LOGIC - Medium: Success] *(A damp mountain gale rattles the tarnished plates of his gorget. He exhales a gray plume smelling of bitter chicory and cold tallow.)* Look at the driftwood wedged against the weir, Commander. Those aren't peasant hay-carts—those are Border Mint bullion wagons burned down to the iron axle-trees. Secure Sunken Ford first, then push into the marsh and the northern timber depots.
text.msg.2: [TACTICAL CALCULUS - Easy: Success] *(Mud cakes his brow as he holds up a lead-sealed ledger tube pried from the burned tollhouse.)* Sunken Ford is held! Recovered toll ledgers confirm Grok'tar was paid in stamped Border Mint copper to destroy tax records before Oakhaven auditors arrived.
text.msg.3: [WAR LOGIC - Medium: Success] *(The whale-oil beacons flare bright blue above the peat sinks, driving back the marsh mist.)* Malgath's pyre-chanters lie broken in Lantern Passage. The southern ravine trail is open.
text.msg.4: [ASTRAL SHIVER - Challenging: Success] *(He holds a smoldering bundle of bog-myrtle and vinegar-soaked rags to his nose.)* Ravenwatch Keep's outer courtyard is secured and the bone totems lie shattered. The subterranean stair into the Weeping Ossuary yawns open before us.
text.msg.5: [PRIMORDIAL RECKONING - Formidable: Success] *(Morvessa's brass abacus clatters into the ash of the Ossuary as the white silk cocoons shrivel.)* The Silk Widow has fallen! We have recovered her Border Mint Seal Ring and the stolen southern bullion waybills pointing straight into Redmarsh.
text.msg.6: [COHORT MEMORY - Easy: Success] *(Iron-shod wagon wheels rumble across the wet granite arches while your vanguard holds the western cutwater.)* Alder Bridge stands unbroken! Three thousand river-parish refugees have safely crossed toward the southern road.
text.msg.7: [WAR LOGIC - Heroic: Success] *(The southern portcullis groans open, revealing the alkali dust-haze of the Redmarsh depression beyond.)* Ashbrook Gatehouse is ours and Siege Commander Velen has fallen! The southern road into Redmarsh Outpost lies open.
text.msg.8: [QUARTERMASTER'S EYE - Medium: Success] *(He weighs a clipped silver groat against Assayer Pell's recovered brass balance.)* Pell's assay scales and the Clipped Coin Investigation ledger have been recovered from the burned Border Mint vaults.
text.msg.9: [ASTRAL SHIVER - Challenging: Success] *(Sparks dance along the translucent green glass pried from the slag-heaps.)* Krazak the Volt Stalker is slain! Three shards of high-capacitance Vitrified Slag have been harvested to ground our wards.
text.msg.10: [QUARTERMASTER'S EYE - Easy: Success] *(The great timber water-wheel groans back into motion as the wedged iron bars come free.)* Skara lies dead among the sawdust and Greywood Sawmill is cutting siege-timber for Thornwick once more!
text.msg.11: [VISCERAL DREAD - Challenging: Success] *(The ancient ironbark colossus crashes into the quarry mud, its stone carapace splitting in two.)* Thornmaw the Ironroot has crumbled into inert granite! The moorland packs scatter into the crags.
text.msg.12: [CHILL OF THE VEIL - Formidable: Success] *(Acidic gall-ink curls into black smoke upon the scriptorium lectern.)* The Lower-Parish Probate Lien-Roll burns to cinders. Miller Tobin and the indebted dead of Thornwick are finally released from posthumous service.
text.msg.13: [QUARTERMASTER'S EYE - Challenging: Success] *(Cold mountain water roars down the spillway as the dwarven bronze wheel locks into place.)* Undervault Gallery Four is drained, exposing the bricked-up tax-commission silver bars!
text.npc.hale: Hold the river crossings and keep your powder dry, Commander. If Alder Bridge falls, three northern parishes die in the mud.
text.npc.marlow: Someone burned the Border Mint six winters ago to hide shaved silver groats. Bring me Assayer Pell's ledger from the northern ruins and Thornwick's treasury will reward you.
text.npc.miller: Morvessa's irregulars hamstrung our draft-oxen and wedged iron crowbars into the Greywood sawmill wheel. Clear the canopy and free the mill!
text.npc.bren: Grok'tar holds the eastern gravel bar at Sunken Ford, and green marsh-lights are luring turf-cutters off the boardwalks in Fenwick's Peat.
text.npc.orlen: Beneath Ravenwatch Keep lies the Weeping Ossuary. Morvessa's probate clerks bound the dead in gall-ink and fed the unpaid tax-rolls to the Silk Widow.
text.win: The Border Fords and the Weeping Ossuary are cleansed. Your vanguard marches south toward Redmarsh Outpost.
text.fail.1: Your hero has fallen in the mud of the northern frontier.
